name: Sr-19
summary: RCS-4, or 1-pentyl-3-(4-methoxybenzoyl)indole, is a synthetic cannabinoid drug sold under the names SR-19, BTM-4, or Eric-4 (later shortened to E-4), but originally, OBT-199.

pharmacology.text: RCS-4 is a potent cannabinoid receptor agonist, with EC50 values of 146 nM for human CB1 receptors, and 46 nM for human CB2 receptors. All methoxyphenyl regioisomers, and N-butyl homologues of RCS-4 and its regioisomers also display potent agonist activities at CB1 and CB2 receptors.

uses.text: RCS-4, or 1-pentyl-3-(4-methoxybenzoyl)indole, is a synthetic cannabinoid drug sold under the names SR-19, BTM-4, or Eric-4 (later shortened to E-4), but originally, OBT-199.

summaryZh: RCS-4，化學名N-正戊基-3-(4-甲氧基苯甲醯基)吲哚（英語：N-pentyl-3-indole），分子式C21H23NO2，屬於苯甲醯基吲哚類大麻素，是大麻素受體CB1和CB2的激動劑。
summaryZhHans: RCS-4，化学名N-正戊基-3-(4-甲氧基苯甲酰基)吲哚（英语：N-pentyl-3-indole），分子式C21H23NO2，属于苯甲酰基吲哚类大麻素，是大麻素受体CB1和CB2的激动剂。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the synthetic cannabinoids, can cause a racing heart, anxiety and panic, vomiting, confusion, psychosis and seizures, and some have caused deaths.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。其所屬的合成大麻素類藥物可能造成心跳加速、焦慮與恐慌、嘔吐、意識混亂、精神病症狀與癲癇發作，部分已造成死亡。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。其所属的合成大麻素类药物可能造成心跳加速、焦虑与恐慌、呕吐、意识混乱、精神病症状与癫痫发作，部分已造成死亡。

fact.en: It has gone by many trade names: it started as OBT-199 and was later sold as SR-19, BTM-4 and Eric-4, which was then shortened to E-4.
fact.zh: 它曾使用許多商品名稱：最初叫OBT-199，之後以SR-19、BTM-4和Eric-4販售，後來又簡稱為E-4。
fact.zhHans: 它曾使用许多商品名称：最初叫OBT-199，之后以SR-19、BTM-4和Eric-4贩售，后来又简称为E-4。
